summary: What building motion levels, the spring and Presence taught, written into skills. design-component (shipped) gains §1d and reference/motion-sheets.md — the motion-sheet format (principles, filmstrips per phase, motion-levels table, dark with measured transient contrast, token map, gaps), the decisions such a sheet must put to the user, and Paper traps (the remote renderer does not resolve tokens or load the face, so its screenshots and exports are not evidence; the open file drops mid-session; moving an approved sheet to the handoff page) — plus scripts/motion-frames.mjs, which computes every frame value from a token curve and samples a damped spring as linear(), reproducing --ui-ease-spring exactly. New authoring skill motion-component: the API shape that worked for Presence, its lifecycle traps (focus before imperative inert, DOM-sibling neighbours, waiting for an item's own animations), and how to measure motion in Chromium. add-component and review-ui gain the first-of-its-kind traps (a new Tailwind variant, useRender for ref merging, rendersNoColour, visual baselines, catalogue motifs, the cloud-session Playwright browser path, flow-start).
